item.title: 'Childhood crisis': Oregon lawmakers consider AI safeguards for youth mental health
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) – Oregon lawmakers are considering a bill that would put safeguards on artificial intelligence chatbots in an effort to protect youth mental health. Senate Bill 1546 would place regulations on AI chatbot platforms, such as ChatGPT, Grok or Claude, where chatbots mimic personal conversations.
